title: Best Script For Mobile and PC Macro Reacord  Auto Placement
features:
Macro Recording Suite

> Auto-Replay Macro - Automatically replay selected macros

> Manual Recording Controls - Start/stop recording with full control

> Auto Vote System - Automatically vote for next story or replay

> Auto Teleport Lobby - Return to lobby when matches end

Auto Placement System

> Smart Unit Placement - Automatically places units during gameplay

> Upgrade While Placing - Instantly upgrade units while continuing placement

> Cost Priority Control - Choose between highest/lowest cost units first

> Slot Unit Types - Configure ground/air units for each slot

Map Teleporter

> Auto Teleport - Automatically teleport to selected maps

> Difficulty Selection - Choose from multiple difficulty levels

> Category Support - Story, Legend, and Raids modes

> Act Selection - Navigate through different acts

***This script is still in beta. If you spot bugs or have suggestions, please report them.***
